newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper gains, London stocks fall to new low.
newsitem.headline: India copper gains, London stocks fall to new low.

text.p: Indian copper prices regained on Monday on rising world prices and reports that London market stocks had fallen to a six-year low, dealers said.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 11,900 on fresh industrial buying along with restricted imports, one dealer said.
Copper was up by 150 rupees per quintal on Saturday.
Zinc was steady at 6,375 rupees, tin at 34,100 rupees and nickel at 36,800 rupees on fresh physical support.
"Reports of state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd raising selling prices of zinc by 700 rupees per tonne for second half of the current month had little impact on the market today," he said.
